meta.layer: strict — one-level argument-origin backtracking only; IDA per-arg push annotations (Str/Src/Size/LPSTR/...) take priority, contiguous-push reverse-positional fallback (last push = arg0)

entity_conventions.P:<fnhex>:<k>: k-th stack param of function (thiscall this excluded, k=0 first)
entity_conventions.G:<addrhex>: global (IDA auto-name embedded addr + anchors/ida_global_types.json name->addr; global-base alias reg (mov reg,offset G) turns [reg+off] into G:addr+off)
entity_conventions.M:<fnhex>:this:0x<off>: this member (off>0 for char* evidence; off=0 allowed only for u64 pairs — 64-bit data usage rules out vfptr)

type_semantics.crt-str-arg-inline: inline buffer (push offset G / lea [this+off]) -> char[N] candidate set (all char[N] spellings in universe; OR-domain = 'some char array')
type_semantics.memcpy-src-member: memcpy src = address-of member + immediate length N -> char[N] (spelling must exist in universe)
type_semantics.memcpy-src-member-anyN: memcpy src = address-of member, length not immediate -> char[N] candidate set
type_semantics.memcpy-src-member-value: memcpy src = pointer member (deref) -> char* (extension, separately tagged)
type_semantics.wsprintfA-dst: wsprintfA dst buffer (fmt verified literal-annotated) -> char* / char[N] candidate set
type_semantics.u64-regpair: __aulldiv/__aullrem/__allmul operand: eax/edx defs from the same base at adjacent offsets (either orientation) -> unsigned long long
type_semantics.u64-stackpair: __aulldiv/__aullrem/__allmul operand: adjacent push pair (incl. register pushes whose defs trace to the same base at adjacent offsets) -> unsigned long long

notes: C1 core set per task: _strlen/_strcpy/_strcat/_strcmp/_strncmp; same-semantics extension _strnicmp/_strchr/_strstr included with separable crt_fn labels.

C2: memcpy/memset DESTINATION may be an embedded object (whole-struct copy/zeroing) — char[N] would be unsound there, so dst origins are counted only (misc_stats.mem_dst_count_only); the src rule follows the task spec (address-of member + imm length).
C4: FILE* spelling absent from type_universe -> fread/fwrite counted only (misc_stats.fileio_FILE_star_absent_in_universe); fopen path/mode emit char*.

C5: signed 64-bit spelling absent from type_universe -> __alldiv/__allrem counted only (unsigned spelling would be semantically wrong for signed ops); __allmul emits 'unsigned long long' as the only 64-bit scalar spelling (sign-agnostic multiply).
cdq-derived edx is not a 64-bit pair half (32-bit value sign-extended => 32-bit provenance).
char[N] candidate sets are OR-domains ('is some char array'); intersect soundly with other families.

Title mentions exception-handling patterns, but the task enumerates five concrete CRT classes only; no EH-specific evidence class (e.g. _except_handler3 frame walks) was specified — CRT sites living inside ExceptionHandler.cpp (wsprintfA etc.) are captured by the CRT classes.
callee-saved registers (ebx/esi/edi/ebp) may be traced across intervening calls (MSVC ABI preserves them); caller-saved (eax/ecx/edx) stop at the nearest call.
